_comment: Sample AFTERS response for the seed event 'Build Night: Repo Rescue'. Matches AiResponse<MetricsData> in src/lib/ai/types.ts. Use as a fixture when building against the metrics role.
summary: AFTERS package for Build Night: Repo Rescue (confirmed). Weekly hands-on session where members bring stuck projects, broken repos, or half-finished ideas. Nothing is saved until you apply it.
suggestions: Log attendance first — every other number reads against it.
Apply the +1 week and +1 month follow-ups so momentum does not decay.
The thank-you note lands in Approvals as a draft; an officer still sends it.

metrics.notes: Previously logged 24 — record the delta so trends stay readable.

metrics.notes: Officer + mentor hours, setup through cleanup

followUps.title: Send thank-you note to attendees and mentors
followUps.notes: Within 48 hours, while the event is still fresh. Goes through Approvals.

followUps.title: Close out 2 open tasks from run-up
followUps.notes: Prepare mentor signup sheet · Stock snacks and name tags

followUps.title: Share pulse survey results with officers
followUps.notes: +1 week: summarize what to keep and change for the next Build Night: Repo Rescue.

followUps.title: Re-invite first-timers to the next event

wentWell: Prep held up: 1 of 4 run-up tasks were done before doors opened (e.g. confirm room booking with makerspace).
The 5-block run of show kept the room moving — no dead air between segments.
Progress on the stated goal: help 3+ members unblock a pr or local dev setup.
improve: 3 tasks slipped past the event (post #build-night reminder in club slack) — pull the deadline a week earlier next time.
Sign-in was the bottleneck at the door; pre-print name tags for anyone who RSVP'd.
Under-served goal: recruit 2 volunteers for next month's workshop — assign one officer to own it explicitly.
quotes: "I finally got my dev environment running — I'd been stuck for weeks." — attendee, Build Night: Repo Rescue
"Having someone sit with me for ten minutes beat an hour of docs." — first-time attendee
"Tell me when the next one is; I want to bring a friend." — returning member
nextEventIdeas: Build Night: Repo Rescue: part two, same format, with a dedicated newcomer table
Officer-led mini workshop on the single question that came up most tonight
Partner co-host session to bring in a new audience

surveyQuestions: How likely are you to recommend Build Night: Repo Rescue to a friend? (1–5)
What is one thing you got done or learned tonight?
What slowed you down or felt confusing?
What should we run next month?
Would you like to help mentor at a future event? (yes / maybe / no)
insights: Already logged: attendance 24 people, new signups 7 people.
1 follow-up still open — oldest is "Survey attendees on onboarding docs".
Event status is confirmed; mark it completed once AFTERS is filled in so it stops showing as upcoming work.
Thank-you notes sent within 48 hours are the cheapest retention lever a club has.

draftPreview.subject: Thank you — Build Night: Repo Rescue
draftPreview.body:
Thanks for coming to Build Night: Repo Rescue on Aug 12! 🙌

The room was full of people helping each other out, and it showed. We set out to help 3+ members unblock a pr or local dev setup — you made that happen.

Two quick things:
1. Tell us how it went — the 4-question pulse survey takes under a minute.
2. Save the date for the next one; bring the project you did not get to tonight.

If you want to help mentor next time, reply here and we will add you to the list.

— The officer team
